preflight_steps.detail: --ref given and equal to the hg38 base
2048 bp window centred on the variant, causal log-softmax

units: nats (summed log-probability difference over the window)

score_definitions.delta_loglik: sum over the window (default 2,048 bp) of log P(base_i | prefix) for the ALT sequence minus the REF sequence, from the causal log-softmax of the unembed logits. Negative = ALT window less likely under the model; a proxy for constraint, no tissue, no direction of effect.
score_definitions.delta_logprob_at_variant: the same difference at the variant position only (one base), not the windowed sum.
score_definitions.delta_emb_norm_at_variant: L2 distance between ALT and REF embeddings at the variant position (block 24); unsigned, a geometry measure, not an effect direction.
